title: Monthly Subscription Price List for Pocketwire Business Profile Tiers
content:
The Pocketwire Business Profile charges a monthly subscription on some tiers only. The subscription fee is stated in US dollars and is charged on the first day of each calendar month; the waiver volume is the net sales volume of the previous calendar month at or above which that month's subscription fee is waived. On tiers without a fee the waiver volume is shown as 0.00. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly subscription fee | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 19.99 | USD 49.99 | USD 149.99 |
| Waiver volume (previous calendar month's net sales) | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 75000.00 | USD 150000.00 | USD 400000.00 |

## Reading the price list

**Which tiers pay a subscription?** Pocketwire Business Pro (USD 19.99), Pocketwire Business Premier (USD 49.99) and Pocketwire Business Enterprise (USD 149.99). Pocketwire Business Starter, Essentials and Growth carry a fee of USD 0.00.

**How does the waiver threshold read?** "At or above" includes the figure itself. On Pocketwire Business Premier, a previous month's net sales volume of exactly USD 150000.00 meets the waiver volume, and USD 149999.99 does not.

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A Pocketwire Business Pro profile whose previous calendar month's net sales volume was USD 80000.00 is at or above USD 75000.00; one whose volume was USD 60000.00 is below it.
